scope: Adversarial failure probes and negative control verifications

controls.name: Corrupt PNG Fixture Rejection
controls.description: Ensures that 40-byte truncated or header-only PNGs are rejected by deep chunk validation.
controls.input: 40-byte PNG buffer (header + IHDR only; missing IDAT/IEND/CRC validation)

observedResult.error: Corrupt or invalid PNG artifact: PNG missing required IDAT chunk

controls.name: Corrupt PDF Fixture Rejection
controls.description: Ensures that 78-byte keyword-only fake PDFs are rejected by structural parser.
controls.input: 78-byte PDF buffer (%PDF-1.7 header + text only; missing /Catalog, /Pages, xref, %%EOF)

observedResult.error: Corrupt or invalid PDF artifact: Malformed PDF document: missing required structural elements (xref, trailer, /Root, /Pages catalog, or /Page object)

controls.name: Cross-Tenant Document Write Defense
controls.description: Ensures that a request from Tenant B cannot modify a design created by Tenant A.
controls.input: Tenant 'audit-tenant-b' attempting to apply operations to document owned by 'audit-tenant-a'

controls.name: Nonexistent Document Render Defense
controls.description: Ensures that calling render() on a document ID that was never registered fails truthfully.

controls.name: Local-Only Model Egress Defense
controls.description: Ensures that when egressPolicy is 'local_only' or token budget is 0, no external HTTP calls are dispatched.
controls.expectedResult: Zero network requests; deterministic fallback with usage.inputTokens=0, usage.outputTokens=0

controls.name: Unentitled Model Honest Blocker Handling
controls.description: Ensures that if an upstream model (e.g. gpt-6-astra) is unentitled, the provider receipt is recorded honestly without faking tokens, and fallback is explicit.
controls.input: OpenAI API request for gpt-6-astra on project proj_Joi7d0agEUBGRv7hTEVp6szc
controls.expectedResult: HTTP 403 recorded in MODEL_RECEIPTS.json; cascade to admitted deployment gpt-4.1 with live_provider provenance

observedResult.message: Project `proj_Joi7d0agEUBGRv7hTEVp6szc` does not have access to model `gpt-6-astra`

controls.name: Unsolicited Copy & Boilerplate Purge
controls.description: Ensures that unrequested statutory laws, email footers, and official banner decorations are not injected into native Canva text nodes.
controls.input: KAAE invitation exact copy from KAAE_INVITATION_EXACT_COPY.txt
controls.expectedResult: Zero unrequested text nodes matching statutory laws, info@, www., or banner decorations

controls.name: Extra Paragraph Preservation
controls.description: Ensures that supplementary body paragraphs in user briefs are not dropped or truncated.
controls.input: Invitation text + 'Accessibility assistance is available on request.'
controls.expectedResult: extraParagraphPreserved: true in parsed domain and rendered nodes
